title.en: Stylish coat trims despite clipper nicks

text.en: Most pet owners are delighted with their dogs haircuts, describing the styling as meticulous, handsome, and picture-worthy after bath and blowout sessions. In contrast, one long-time client reported recurring scissor or clipper nicks on recent visits, voicing disappointment over declining consistency.

Clients frequently highlight the friendly, accommodating attitude of the grooming team, noting that stylists listen carefully to specific cut instructions. However, a dissatisfied customer felt that management failed to provide adequate accountability or proactive reassurance after an accidental nick.

title.en: Enthusiastic visits with anxiety after injury

text.en: Several reviewers mention that their dogs eagerly anticipate visits to the salon and show complete comfort with the grooming staff. Conversely, a customer noted that repeated grooming injuries left their pet noticeably anxious and fearful of returning to the boutique.

q.en: Can appointments be booked online at Ball and Biscuit Grooming?

a.en: Yes, clients can book grooming appointments online through the salon booking calendar on their website.

q.en: How does the salon manage cancellations and waitlists?

a.en: Clients note that the salon promptly contacts waitlisted pet owners when cancellation openings arise.

q.en: What treatments are included in standard grooming packages?

a.en: Services include warm baths, blowouts, breed-specific coat trims, deshedding treatments, and nail clipping.

q.en: How does the team accommodate specific styling requests?

a.en: Reviewers mention that groomers listen attentively to custom length preferences and specific coat styling instructions.
